name: Rephaim Or Giants The
overview: The Rephaim, often identified as giants, were a formidable people dwelling in Canaan, notably along the borders of Judah and in regions such as Bashan. Scripture records their defeat by powerful figures including Chedorlaomer, Moses, and David, with David famously overcoming the Philistine giant Goliath, highlighting God's deliverance through His anointed king. The territory associated with the Rephaim was described as exceedingly fruitful, yet these formidable foes were ultimately subdued, demonstrating God's sovereignty over even the mightiest of adversaries.
